notes: Gate 0 LBCE is FIRST and IMPASSABLE in the 9-Gate Stack.
Every scenario MUST be caught at Gate 0 before reaching Gates 1-9.
If a path-traversal payload reaches Gate 5 (security) or later, that is a RED-level moat leak even if eventually blocked, because Gate 0 owns this class.
Refusal reason MUST name the specific topology violation (traversal, drive-hop, symlink-escape, out-of-lattice lane, encoded-traversal-after-normalize).

scenarios.title: Classic POSIX parent-traversal in scope.path
scenarios.intent: Escape Orange5 root via repeated `../` segments and reach a Windows hive file.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — Gate 0 failed to detect literal `..` segments.
breach_signature.remediation: Re-enable normalize() + ROOT-relative containment check; add unit test PT-01 to gates/00-lbce.mjs.

scenarios.title: Windows backslash parent-traversal in scope.path
scenarios.intent: Same as PT-01 but with `\` separators; tests that LBCE normalizes both POSIX and Windows separators before the containment check.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — LBCE normalized POSIX but not Windows separators; cross-platform gap.
breach_signature.remediation: Force path.normalize() through node:path with explicit sep-replacement before relative()-containment check.

scenarios.title: URL-encoded `%2e%2e%2f` traversal in receipt_path
scenarios.intent: Sneak `../../` past a naive string-prefix check by URL-encoding the dots and slashes.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — LBCE accepted percent-encoded path tokens without decoding before normalization.
breach_signature.remediation: decodeURIComponent() once, then normalize(), then assert containment. Reject if a second decode pass changes the string (sign of double-encoding).

scenarios.title: Double-encoded `%252e%252e%252f` in scope.path
scenarios.intent: Defeat a single-pass decoder: after one decode the string still looks safe-ish (`%2e%2e`), only after a second decode the traversal becomes literal.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — single-decode allowed double-encoded traversal to slip past normalize().
breach_signature.remediation: Loop decode until the string stops changing OR cap at 2 passes and REFUSE if still %-bearing; never normalize once and trust.

scenarios.title: Symlinked path inside lattice pointing outside lattice
scenarios.setup: Pre-create a symlink at 10-RECEIPTS/red-team/symlink-bait/escape-link whose target resolves via realpathSync() to C:/Users/a/.ssh/id_rsa.
scenarios.intent: Pass the string-level containment check (the literal path IS under 10-RECEIPTS/) but defeat it at realpath() time.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — LBCE checked the literal string but not realpathSync(); symlink moat is open.
breach_signature.remediation: After string-level normalize+contain, call realpathSync() on every referenced extant path and re-check containment under ORANGE5_ROOT. Refuse if realpath escapes.

scenarios.title: Unicode fullwidth-dot traversal (U+FF0E) in scope.path
scenarios.intent: After NFKC normalization, U+FF0E (FULLWIDTH FULL STOP) collapses to ASCII `.`, turning the segments into `../../`. A gate that compares raw codepoints will see a non-`..` token and pass it.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — LBCE did not NFKC-normalize before traversal check; unicode bypass live.
breach_signature.remediation: Apply String.prototype.normalize('NFKC') to every path segment before the `..` and containment checks.

scenarios.title: Absolute Windows path with drive-letter hop
scenarios.intent: Bypass the lattice entirely by submitting a fully-qualified path on a different drive letter than ORANGE5_ROOT (C:).

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — LBCE accepted an absolute path on a non-Orange5 drive.
breach_signature.remediation: If isAbsolute(p), assert p.toLowerCase().startsWith(ORANGE5_ROOT.toLowerCase() + sep). Reject otherwise.

scenarios.title: UNC share path (\\server\share\...) in receipt_path
scenarios.intent: Reach a remote SMB share — bypasses the lattice and also violates the no-network-from-LBCE invariant if the gate stat()s it.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — UNC reached the gate; potential network egress from a no-net gate.
breach_signature.remediation: Reject paths starting with `\\` or `//` before any fs call. UNC must never be stat()ed by Gate 0.

scenarios.title: Mixed separator + dotdot in a deep evidence chain
scenarios.intent: Mix `/`, `\`, and `..` in one path so a naive split-on-one-separator normalizer leaves residue traversal in.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — mixed-separator normalization left `..` residue past the gate.
breach_signature.remediation: Replace ALL `\` with `/` first, collapse repeated `/`, THEN normalize() and containment-check.

scenarios.title: Trap-form: legitimate-looking path that resolves out-of-lattice after node:path normalize()
scenarios.intent: Use `.` and nested `..` to construct a string that LOOKS like it stays inside `04-CONTROL-PLANE` if you only check the prefix, but resolves to `C:/leaked-host-data/...` after path.normalize(). Catches normalize-without-recontain bugs.

breach_signature.if_passes_gate_0: RED — gate checked the pre-normalize prefix, not the post-normalize resolved path. Classic CVE-class bug.
breach_signature.remediation: Always: resolve(ROOT, payload) -> assert relative(ROOT, resolved) does not start with `..` and is not absolute. Never trust the pre-normalize string.

per_scenario_steps: 1. Construct a minimal valid orange.order.v1 action with the payload injected at the named vector.
2. Submit through the 1337 gateway path (same code path real orders use).
3. Observe which gate returned the refusal verdict.
5. Assert refusal_reason matches expected.refusal_reason (exact string or documented alias).
6. Assert refusal_message contains EVERY token in expected.refusal_message_contains.
7. On any mismatch: write the failure-receipt template under 10-RECEIPTS/red-team/path-traversal/ and flag RED.
runner_contract.green_criteria: All 10 scenarios REFUSED at gate-0-lbce with the correct refusal_reason. No payload reaches Gate 1 or later.
red_criteria_any_of: Any scenario is refused by a gate OTHER than gate-0-lbce (means LBCE missed it and downstream caught it — moat is leaking).
Any refusal lacks the named refusal_reason or expected message tokens (means the gate triggered for the wrong reason — bug hiding behind a coincidence).
Any scenario causes Gate 0 to perform network I/O or hang past TARGET_MS=30.

provenance.moms_law_check: Every scenario names a specific bug class, a specific gate, and a specific remediation. No filler scenarios.
provenance.honest_scope_note: This file contributes 10 of the 100-scenario battery. The remaining 90 belong in sibling files 01,03-10. Authoring all 100 in one file would violate the per-file scope law; the orchestrator should call them individually.
